goal: Das blockierte I167-Abschlussgate mit einem fokussierten Chromium-Harness und eindeutiger GREEN-, BLOCKED- und RED-Semantik reproduzierbar vorbereiten.

guide_delta.summary: Die I167-Anleitung nennt jetzt den vorbereiteten Einzelbefehl und erklärt, dass ein fehlender Browser als BLOCKED statt als Produktfehler gemeldet wird.

direct_dependencies: I167 required-preview DOM and transient rule contract
tests_required: Node syntax check for the I167 Chromium harness
Python compile for the I167 gate wrapper
deterministic BLOCKED result when no Chrome/Chromium executable exists
single-source preflight and manifest V2 validation
tests_explicitly_not_run: real Chromium interaction and screenshot gate because the environment has no browser binary
product regressions because product code is unchanged
storage deep gate because repository and schema are unchanged
risks: the real interaction assertions remain unexecuted until Chromium is available
future DOM changes may require synchronized selector updates
a BLOCKED result must never be presented as GREEN
non_changes: no TODO, roadmap or progress closure
no screenshot claimed without a real browser run
no persistence, repository or schema change
expected_side_effects: a browser-equipped runner can execute the complete I167 gate with one command
missing browser infrastructure is reported separately from product failures
A-M product progress remains 40 of 132 pending real Chromium evidence
